verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated export feature, but you can pull your data out yourself by listing and fetching ingested documents through the API and official SDKs (docs-60, docs-26). Container-scoped deletion lets you remove your data when you leave (docs-12). Self-hosting as a single binary keeps your data on your own hardware (docs-7, docs-8). Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all data (documents, memories, graph, profiles), stated open export formats such as JSON or Markdown, an export path for derived memories and the knowledge graph, and independent confirmation that leaving works in practice.
